lead.claim: Cognitive frailty in rural older adults may be reversible, especially in early stages.
lead.context: Why this matters: This prospective cohort study examined transitions and predictive factors of cognitive frailty states in rural older adults.

supporting.claim: Self-evaluation of temporal gait asymmetry may be more accurate than spatial asymmetry.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This study explored how neurotypical young adults self-evaluate induced temporal and spatial gait asymmetry.

supporting.claim: OTC analgesic use may be associated with faster return to play post-concussion.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This study investigated the association between OTC analgesic use and recovery in athletes after concussion.

supporting.claim: Do multi-component interventions for active aging consistently report implementation outcomes?
supporting.context: Why this matters: This overview of systematic reviews examined how implementability is ensured in multi-component interventions for active aging in older people.
